table.title: [Disaster Relief and Reconstruction Appropriations, by Ministry]
table.caption_extra: [Context, added by the transcriber: itemization of the disaster relief and reconstruction disbursements decided after the 1934 natural disasters — ¥70,691,259 for 1934-35, ¥66,105,116 for 1935-36 and ¥79,279,968 for 1936-37 and after, total ¥216,076,343.] The itemization of this continuous disbursement follows (in yen):

rows: Aid to restituting works of the Osaka harbor
Aid to the emergent outlays of schools in the affected districts
Encouragement of school-attendance of children in the affected districts
Various readjustment works in the affected districts

transcriber_notes: Rows: 23 as printed (22 items incl. ministry sub-totals, + Total). Indented rows are the items under the preceding ministry (Home Affairs: 6 items; Education: 4; Agriculture and Forestry: 3).

Row 'Other purposes' (under Education), col 'Total': printed '4,33?,008' with the fourth digit broken (6 likely but not certain); left blank. Row (1,500,171+1,215,161+1,620,676) and the Education total imply 4,336,008.

3-vs-8 (BRIEF exception): Row 'Other purposes' (under Home Affairs): cells printed 2,31?,967 / ?,???,?00 / 1?,049,220 with indistinct 3/8; all 256 combinations tried: only 2,313,967 / 3,383,300 / 13,049,220 reconciles with the row total 18,746,487 and the Home Affairs sub-totals in cols 1934-35, 1935-36, 1936-37 — used.

3-vs-8 (BRIEF exception): Row 'Restitution works': 8,315,0?1 (1934-35) and 10,337,7?1 (1935-36) look like ...081 and ...731 in print; only 8,315,031 and 10,337,781 make the Agriculture and Forestry sub-totals (24,023,582; 25,649,977) reconcile (the row total 37,036,568 reconciles either way) — used.

Totals: every row reconciles (Total = 1934-35 + 1935-36 + 1936-37) except 'Other purposes' (Education), unverifiable because of the blank cell. Ministry sub-totals Home Affairs (all 4 cols), Education (cols 2-4; col 1 would need 4,336,008), Agriculture and Forestry (all 4 cols) reconcile. Grand Total row 216,076,343 / 70,691,259 / 66,105,116 / 79,279,968: sum of ministry rows reconciles in all 4 columns.
